firstProbe.offerHypothesis: Convert a buyer's messy notes/problem/context into a concise prioritized action plan or decision brief using AI-assisted research/reasoning, with transparent scope and no regulated professional advice.
whyThisOffer: fulfillment can occur almost entirely inside ChatGPT
does not require Sean to possess coding expertise
input/output can be routed by copy/paste
marginal human burden remains low if order volume grows
can be priced low enough to target first material fruit rather than maximum margin
killConditions: Fiverr requires any upfront payment or paid identity verification
existing PayPal is not sufficiently verified for payout and verifying it requires a banking step Sean will not use
gig creation requires material technical work or recurring manual service beyond routing
platform rules prohibit the truthful AI-assisted fulfillment model
firstProbe.fallback: Ko-fi or Payhip direct-PayPal page plus a separate zero-cost demand-discovery probe; do not confuse the storefront with demand.

stillness.nextHumanBoundary: Attempt free Fiverr seller/gig setup only until the first fee, unsupported verification, or high-burden requirement appears; do not pay. If clean, publish one minimal offer and observe demand.
stillness.materialFruitDefinition: Only settled/withdrawable buyer payment attributable to completed useful work counts.
stillness.antiLockIn: Fiverr is a probe surface, not Flower's business model or ontology.
